newsitem.title: USA: Blyth Industries sets three-for-two split.
newsitem.headline: Blyth Industries sets three-for-two split.

text.p: Blyth Industries Inc said on Thursday that its directors had approved a three-for-two stock split of its common stock, a transaction expected to leave roughly 49 million shares of common stock outstanding.
Blyth said shareholders of record on June 16 will receive one additional share, in the form of a stock dividend for every two shares they own.
Blyth said it will distribute the additional shares on or around June 26. Blyth Industries manufactures candles and home fragrance products.
